import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
import sys

print("Loading cell line IDs...", flush=True)
# Read cell line IDs from both files
crispr_ids = pd.read_csv('/workspace/inputs/CRISPRGeneEffect.csv', usecols=[0]).iloc[:, 0].tolist()
omics_ids = pd.read_csv('/workspace/inputs/OmicsExpressionProteinCodingGenesTPMLogp1BatchCorrected.csv', usecols=[0]).iloc[:, 0].tolist()

crispr_ids_set = set(crispr_ids)
omics_ids_set = set(omics_ids)
common_ids = sorted(crispr_ids_set & omics_ids_set)
print(f"Common cell lines: {len(common_ids)}", flush=True)

# Create boolean masks for rows to keep
crispr_row_mask = [i for i, cid in enumerate(crispr_ids) if cid in omics_ids_set]
omics_row_map = {cid: i for i, cid in enumerate(omics_ids) if cid in crispr_ids_set}

print("Parsing gene headers...", flush=True)
# Read headers to get gene lists
crispr_header = pd.read_csv('/workspace/inputs/CRISPRGeneEffect.csv', nrows=0).columns.tolist()
omics_header = pd.read_csv('/workspace/inputs/OmicsExpressionProteinCodingGenesTPMLogp1BatchCorrected.csv', nrows=0).columns.tolist()

def parse_gene_name(col_name):
    col_name = col_name.strip()
    if '(' in col_name:
        return col_name.split('(')[0].strip()
    return col_name

# Build gene name -> column index mappings
crispr_gene_to_col = {}
for i, col in enumerate(crispr_header[1:], 1):  # skip first unnamed col
    gene = parse_gene_name(col)
    if gene not in crispr_gene_to_col:
        crispr_gene_to_col[gene] = i

omics_gene_to_col = {}
for i, col in enumerate(omics_header[1:], 1):
    gene = parse_gene_name(col)
    if gene not in omics_gene_to_col:
        omics_gene_to_col[gene] = i

# Find common genes
common_genes = sorted(set(crispr_gene_to_col.keys()) & set(omics_gene_to_col.keys()))
print(f"Common genes: {len(common_genes)}", flush=True)

# Build column indices for reading
crispr_cols_to_read = [0] + [crispr_gene_to_col[g] for g in common_genes]
omics_cols_to_read = [0] + [omics_gene_to_col[g] for g in common_genes]

print("Loading CRISPR data...", flush=True)
crispr_df = pd.read_csv(
    '/workspace/inputs/CRISPRGeneEffect.csv',
    usecols=crispr_cols_to_read,
    dtype=np.float32
)
# Filter to common cell lines
crispr_df = crispr_df.iloc[crispr_row_mask]
crispr_df = crispr_df.set_index(crispr_df.columns[0])
crispr_df.columns = common_genes
print(f"CRISPR data shape: {crispr_df.shape}", flush=True)

print("Loading expression data...", flush=True)
omics_df = pd.read_csv(
    '/workspace/inputs/OmicsExpressionProteinCodingGenesTPMLogp1BatchCorrected.csv',
    usecols=omics_cols_to_read,
    dtype=np.float32
)
# Filter to common cell lines in the same order
omics_row_indices = [omics_row_map[cid] for cid in crispr_df.index]
omics_df = omics_df.iloc[omics_row_indices]
omics_df = omics_df.set_index(omics_df.columns[0])
omics_df.columns = common_genes
print(f"Expression data shape: {omics_df.shape}", flush=True)

# Verify alignment
assert (crispr_df.index == omics_df.index).all(), "Cell line indices don't match!"
assert (crispr_df.columns == omics_df.columns).all(), "Gene columns don't match!"

print("Computing Spearman correlations...", flush=True)

# Convert to numpy for faster access
crispr_arr = crispr_df.to_numpy()
omics_arr = omics_df.to_numpy()

n_cell_lines = crispr_arr.shape[0]
n_genes = crispr_arr.shape[1]

# Compute Spearman correlation for each gene
strong_positive_count = 0
results = []

for j in range(n_genes):
    x = crispr_arr[:, j]
    y = omics_arr[:, j]

    # Remove NaN values
    mask = ~(np.isnan(x) | np.isnan(y))
    if mask.sum() < 10:  # need at least some data points
        continue

    x_clean = x[mask]
    y_clean = y[mask]

    # Check for zero variance
    if np.all(x_clean == x_clean[0]) or np.all(y_clean == y_clean[0]):
        continue

    try:
        rho, pval = spearmanr(x_clean, y_clean)
        if not np.isnan(rho) and rho >= 0.6:
            strong_positive_count += 1
            results.append((common_genes[j], rho, len(x_clean)))
    except Exception as e:
        continue

    if (j + 1) % 1000 == 0:
        print(f"  Processed {j+1}/{n_genes} genes, found {strong_positive_count} with rho >= 0.6 so far...", flush=True)

print(f"\nTotal genes with Spearman rho >= 0.6: {strong_positive_count}", flush=True)

# Write answer
import os
os.makedirs('/workspace/codex_output', exist_ok=True)
with open('/workspace/codex_output/answer.txt', 'w') as f:
    f.write(str(strong_positive_count) + '\n')

print("Done!", flush=True)

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
import sys
import gc

print("Loading cell line IDs...", flush=True)

# Read cell line IDs from both files
crispr_ids_all = pd.read_csv('/workspace/inputs/CRISPRGeneEffect.csv', usecols=[0]).iloc[:, 0].tolist()
omics_ids_all = pd.read_csv('/workspace/inputs/OmicsExpressionProteinCodingGenesTPMLogp1BatchCorrected.csv', usecols=[0]).iloc[:, 0].tolist()

crispr_ids_set = set(crispr_ids_all)
omics_ids_set = set(omics_ids_all)
common_ids_list = sorted(crispr_ids_set & omics_ids_set)
print(f"Common cell lines: {len(common_ids_list)}", flush=True)

# Row indices for common cell lines in each file
crispr_row_indices = [i for i, cid in enumerate(crispr_ids_all) if cid in omics_ids_set]
omics_id_to_row = {cid: i for i, cid in enumerate(omics_ids_all) if cid in crispr_ids_set}

del crispr_ids_all, omics_ids_all
gc.collect()

print("Parsing gene headers...", flush=True)
# Read headers
crispr_header = pd.read_csv('/workspace/inputs/CRISPRGeneEffect.csv', nrows=0).columns.tolist()
omics_header = pd.read_csv('/workspace/inputs/OmicsExpressionProteinCodingGenesTPMLogp1BatchCorrected.csv', nrows=0).columns.tolist()

def parse_gene_name(col_name):
    col_name = col_name.strip()
    if '(' in col_name:
        return col_name.split('(')[0].strip()
    return col_name

# Build gene name -> column index mappings
crispr_gene_to_col = {}
for i, col in enumerate(crispr_header):
    gene = parse_gene_name(col)
    if i > 0 and gene not in crispr_gene_to_col:
        crispr_gene_to_col[gene] = i

omics_gene_to_col = {}
for i, col in enumerate(omics_header):
    gene = parse_gene_name(col)
    if i > 0 and gene not in omics_gene_to_col:
        omics_gene_to_col[gene] = i

# Find common genes
common_genes = sorted(set(crispr_gene_to_col.keys()) & set(omics_gene_to_col.keys()))
print(f"Common genes: {len(common_genes)}", flush=True)

# Build column indices
crispr_cols = [0] + [crispr_gene_to_col[g] for g in common_genes]  # 0 for cell line ID
omics_cols = [0] + [omics_gene_to_col[g] for g in common_genes]

print("Loading CRISPR data...", flush=True)
crispr_df = pd.read_csv(
    '/workspace/inputs/CRISPRGeneEffect.csv',
    usecols=crispr_cols,
)
print(f"CRISPR full shape: {crispr_df.shape}", flush=True)

# Set index and filter rows
crispr_df = crispr_df.iloc[crispr_row_indices]
crispr_df = crispr_df.set_index(crispr_df.columns[0])
crispr_df.index.name = 'cell_line'
crispr_df.columns = common_genes
crispr_df = crispr_df.astype(np.float32)
print(f"CRISPR filtered shape: {crispr_df.shape}", flush=True)

print("Loading expression data...", flush=True)
omics_df = pd.read_csv(
    '/workspace/inputs/OmicsExpressionProteinCodingGenesTPMLogp1BatchCorrected.csv',
    usecols=omics_cols,
)
print(f"Omics full shape: {omics_df.shape}", flush=True)

# Filter rows to common cell lines in same order as CRISPR
omics_row_indices = [omics_id_to_row[cid] for cid in crispr_df.index.tolist()]
omics_df = omics_df.iloc[omics_row_indices]
omics_df = omics_df.set_index(omics_df.columns[0])
omics_df.index.name = 'cell_line'
omics_df.columns = common_genes
omics_df = omics_df.astype(np.float32)
print(f"Omics filtered shape: {omics_df.shape}", flush=True)

# Verify alignment
assert list(crispr_df.index) == list(omics_df.index), "Cell line indices don't match!"
assert list(crispr_df.columns) == list(omics_df.columns), "Gene columns don't match!"

print("Computing Spearman correlations...", flush=True)

# Convert to numpy for faster access
crispr_arr = crispr_df.to_numpy()  # raw CRISPR gene effect scores (negative = essential)
omics_arr = omics_df.to_numpy()     # log(TPM+1) expression

n_cell_lines = crispr_arr.shape[0]
n_genes = crispr_arr.shape[1]

print(f"Computing correlations for {n_genes} genes across {n_cell_lines} cell lines", flush=True)

# Two interpretations:
# 1. Raw: corr(expression, CRISPR_score)  - positive means higher expression -> less essential
# 2. Essentiality: corr(expression, -CRISPR_score) - positive means higher expression -> more essential
# Essentiality = -CRISPR_score (more negative CRISPR = more essential, so essentiality = -score)

count_raw_pos = 0     # rho(expr, raw_crispr) >= 0.6
count_raw_neg = 0     # rho(expr, raw_crispr) <= -0.6
count_ess_pos = 0     # rho(expr, -raw_crispr) >= 0.6  (same as raw_neg)
count_ess_neg = 0     # rho(expr, -raw_crispr) <= -0.6 (same as raw_pos)

for j in range(n_genes):
    x = crispr_arr[:, j]
    y = omics_arr[:, j]

    # Remove NaN values
    mask = ~(np.isnan(x) | np.isnan(y))
    n_valid = mask.sum()
    if n_valid < 10:
        continue

    x_clean = x[mask]
    y_clean = y[mask]

    # Check for constant array (zero variance)
    if np.all(x_clean == x_clean[0]) or np.all(y_clean == y_clean[0]):
        continue

    try:
        rho, pval = spearmanr(x_clean, y_clean)
        if not np.isnan(rho):
            if rho >= 0.6:
                count_raw_pos += 1
            if rho <= -0.6:
                count_raw_neg += 1
                # This is the essentiality interpretation: corr(expr, essentiality) = corr(expr, -crispr) = -corr(expr, crispr)
                # So rho(expr, essentiality) = -rho >= 0.6 when rho <= -0.6
    except Exception:
        continue

    if (j + 1) % 2000 == 0:
        print(f"  Processed {j+1}/{n_genes} genes, raw>=0.6: {count_raw_pos}, raw<=-0.6: {count_raw_neg}...", flush=True)

print(f"\n=== Results ===", flush=True)
print(f"Genes with rho(expression, raw_CRISPR_score) >= 0.6: {count_raw_pos}", flush=True)
print(f"Genes with rho(expression, raw_CRISPR_score) <= -0.6: {count_raw_neg}", flush=True)
print(f"\nIf essentiality = -CRISPR_score:", flush=True)
print(f"Genes with rho(expression, essentiality) >= 0.6 = rho(expr, raw) <= -0.6: {count_raw_neg}", flush=True)
print(f"Genes with rho(expression, essentiality) <= -0.6 = rho(expr, raw) >= 0.6: {count_raw_pos}", flush=True)

# The question: "strong positive Spearman correlation between expression and essentiality"
# Essentiality is the degree to which a gene is essential.
# In DepMap, more negative CRISPR score = more essential.
# So essentiality = -(CRISPR gene effect score).
# Positive correlation between expression and essentiality means:
#   higher expression -> higher essentiality -> more negative CRISPR score
# This is rho(expression, -CRISPR_score) = -rho(expression, CRISPR_score)
# So we need rho(expr, CRISPR_score) <= -0.6

answer = count_raw_neg
print(f"\nANSWER (essentiality interpretation): {answer}", flush=True)
print(f"ANSWER (raw score interpretation): {count_raw_pos}", flush=True)

# Write both possible answers with a note
import os
os.makedirs('/workspace/codex_output', exist_ok=True)

# Based on domain knowledge: essentiality = -CRISPR gene effect score
# CRISPR gene effect: negative = gene knockout reduces fitness = gene is essential
# So essentiality (degree of dependency) = -(gene effect score)
# rho(expr, essentiality) = rho(expr, -gene_effect) = -rho(expr, gene_effect)
# For rho(expr, essentiality) >= 0.6, we need rho(expr, gene_effect) <= -0.6

# However, the question might also be interpreted as using the raw score directly.
# Let me think about which interpretation is more standard...

# In standard DepMap/CRISPR dependency literature:
# - "Gene effect" or "dependency score": negative = essential
# - "Essentiality" as a concept: the degree to which a gene is required
# - Correlation between expression and essentiality typically means:
#   higher expression -> higher essentiality -> positive correlation if essentiality = dependency score reversed

# The answer using essentiality = -CRISPR_score:
with open('/workspace/codex_output/answer.txt', 'w') as f:
    f.write(str(count_raw_neg) + '\n')

print("Done!", flush=True)

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr, rankdata
import gc

print("Step 1: Reading cell line IDs...", flush=True)

# Read cell line IDs from both files
crispr_ids_all = pd.read_csv('/workspace/inputs/CRISPRGeneEffect.csv', usecols=[0]).iloc[:, 0].tolist()
omics_ids_all = pd.read_csv('/workspace/inputs/OmicsExpressionProteinCodingGenesTPMLogp1BatchCorrected.csv', usecols=[0]).iloc[:, 0].tolist()

crispr_ids_set = set(crispr_ids_all)
omics_ids_set = set(omics_ids_all)
common_ids = sorted(crispr_ids_set & omics_ids_set)
print(f"Common cell lines: {len(common_ids)}", flush=True)

print("Step 2: Parsing gene headers...", flush=True)

crispr_header = pd.read_csv('/workspace/inputs/CRISPRGeneEffect.csv', nrows=0).columns.tolist()
omics_header = pd.read_csv('/workspace/inputs/OmicsExpressionProteinCodingGenesTPMLogp1BatchCorrected.csv', nrows=0).columns.tolist()

def parse_gene_name(col_name):
    col_name = col_name.strip()
    if '(' in col_name:
        return col_name.split('(')[0].strip()
    return col_name

# Build maps: gene symbol -> full column name
crispr_gene_to_full = {}
for col in crispr_header[1:]:
    gene = parse_gene_name(col)
    if gene not in crispr_gene_to_full:
        crispr_gene_to_full[gene] = col

omics_gene_to_full = {}
for col in omics_header[1:]:
    gene = parse_gene_name(col)
    if gene not in omics_gene_to_full:
        omics_gene_to_full[gene] = col

common_genes = sorted(set(crispr_gene_to_full.keys()) & set(omics_gene_to_full.keys()))
print(f"Common genes: {len(common_genes)}", flush=True)

# Use FULL column names for usecols
crispr_col_names = ['Unnamed: 0'] + [crispr_gene_to_full[g] for g in common_genes]
omics_col_names = ['Unnamed: 0'] + [omics_gene_to_full[g] for g in common_genes]

print(f"Step 3: Loading CRISPR data ({len(crispr_col_names)} columns)...", flush=True)
crispr_df = pd.read_csv(
    '/workspace/inputs/CRISPRGeneEffect.csv',
    usecols=crispr_col_names,
)
# Rename unnamed column
crispr_df = crispr_df.rename(columns={'Unnamed: 0': 'cell_line'})
# Filter to common cell lines
crispr_df = crispr_df[crispr_df['cell_line'].isin(omics_ids_set)]
crispr_df = crispr_df.set_index('cell_line')
# Rename columns to gene symbols for consistency
crispr_df.columns = common_genes
crispr_df = crispr_df.astype(np.float32)
print(f"CRISPR shape: {crispr_df.shape}", flush=True)

print(f"Step 4: Loading expression data ({len(omics_col_names)} columns)...", flush=True)
omics_df = pd.read_csv(
    '/workspace/inputs/OmicsExpressionProteinCodingGenesTPMLogp1BatchCorrected.csv',
    usecols=omics_col_names,
)
omics_df = omics_df.rename(columns={'Unnamed: 0': 'cell_line'})
omics_df = omics_df[omics_df['cell_line'].isin(crispr_ids_set)]
# Align to same order as CRISPR
omics_df = omics_df.set_index('cell_line')
omics_df = omics_df.loc[crispr_df.index.tolist()]
omics_df.columns = common_genes
omics_df = omics_df.astype(np.float32)
print(f"Expression shape: {omics_df.shape}", flush=True)

# Verify alignment
assert list(crispr_df.index) == list(omics_df.index), "Row mismatch!"
assert list(crispr_df.columns) == list(omics_df.columns), "Column mismatch!"
print("Alignment verified!", flush=True)

# Verify with manual check for a few genes
print("Step 5: Verifying with manual checks...", flush=True)
check_genes = ['SGF29', 'PAICS', 'WNK1', 'ILK', 'MYC']
for gene in check_genes:
    if gene in crispr_df.columns:
        x = crispr_df[gene].values
        y = omics_df[gene].values
        mask = ~(np.isnan(x) | np.isnan(y))
        rho, _ = spearmanr(x[mask], y[mask])
        print(f"  {gene}: spearmanr={rho:.6f}, n={mask.sum()}", flush=True)

print("Step 6: Computing Spearman correlations for all genes...", flush=True)

crispr_arr = crispr_df.to_numpy()
omics_arr = omics_df.to_numpy()

n_cells, n_genes = crispr_arr.shape
print(f"Processing {n_genes} genes across {n_cells} cell lines", flush=True)

count_ge_06 = 0
count_le_neg06 = 0
top_genes_pos = []  # (gene, rho)
top_genes_neg = []  # (gene, rho)

for j in range(n_genes):
    x = crispr_arr[:, j]
    y = omics_arr[:, j]

    mask = ~(np.isnan(x) | np.isnan(y))
    n_valid = mask.sum()
    if n_valid < 10:
        continue

    x_clean = x[mask]
    y_clean = y[mask]

    if np.all(x_clean == x_clean[0]) or np.all(y_clean == y_clean[0]):
        continue

    try:
        rho, _ = spearmanr(x_clean, y_clean)
        if np.isnan(rho):
            continue

        if rho >= 0.6:
            count_ge_06 += 1
            top_genes_pos.append((common_genes[j], rho))
        if rho <= -0.6:
            count_le_neg06 += 1
            top_genes_neg.append((common_genes[j], rho))
    except Exception:
        continue

    if (j + 1) % 2000 == 0:
        print(f"  {j+1}/{n_genes}: rho>=0.6={count_ge_06}, rho<=-0.6={count_le_neg06}", flush=True)

print(f"\n=== FINAL RESULTS ===", flush=True)
print(f"Genes with rho(expression, CRISPR_score) >= 0.6: {count_ge_06}", flush=True)
print(f"Genes with rho(expression, CRISPR_score) <= -0.6: {count_le_neg06}", flush=True)

# The question: "strong positive Spearman correlation between expression and essentiality"
# Interpretation 1: essentiality = CRISPR gene effect score -> answer = count_ge_06
# Interpretation 2: essentiality = -CRISPR gene effect score (degree of dependency) -> answer = count_le_neg06

if top_genes_pos:
    top_genes_pos.sort(key=lambda x: -x[1])
    print("\nTop positive correlations:", flush=True)
    for g, r in top_genes_pos[:10]:
        print(f"  {g}: {r:.6f}", flush=True)

if top_genes_neg:
    top_genes_neg.sort(key=lambda x: x[1])
    print("\nTop negative correlations:", flush=True)
    for g, r in top_genes_neg[:10]:
        print(f"  {g}: {r:.6f}", flush=True)

# Domain knowledge: In DepMap, CRISPR gene effect scores are negative for essential genes.
# "Essentiality" as a concept refers to how dependent a cell line is on a gene.
# Higher essentiality = more negative CRISPR score.
# So: essentiality = -(CRISPR gene effect score)
# Positive correlation between expression and essentiality means:
#   Higher expression -> higher essentiality -> more negative CRISPR score
# This is: rho(expression, -CRISPR_score) >= 0.6
# Which is: rho(expression, CRISPR_score) <= -0.6

# Answer using essentiality interpretation:
answer = count_le_neg06

import os
os.makedirs('/workspace/codex_output', exist_ok=True)
with open('/workspace/codex_output/answer.txt', 'w') as f:
    f.write(str(answer) + '\n')

print(f"\nAnswer written: {answer}", flush=True)

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
import gc

print("Step 1: Reading cell line IDs...", flush=True)

crispr_ids_all = pd.read_csv('/workspace/inputs/CRISPRGeneEffect.csv', usecols=[0]).iloc[:, 0].tolist()
omics_ids_all = pd.read_csv('/workspace/inputs/OmicsExpressionProteinCodingGenesTPMLogp1BatchCorrected.csv', usecols=[0]).iloc[:, 0].tolist()

crispr_ids_set = set(crispr_ids_all)
omics_ids_set = set(omics_ids_all)
common_ids = sorted(crispr_ids_set & omics_ids_set)
print(f"Common cell lines: {len(common_ids)}", flush=True)

print("Step 2: Parsing gene headers...", flush=True)

crispr_header = pd.read_csv('/workspace/inputs/CRISPRGeneEffect.csv', nrows=0).columns.tolist()
omics_header = pd.read_csv('/workspace/inputs/OmicsExpressionProteinCodingGenesTPMLogp1BatchCorrected.csv', nrows=0).columns.tolist()

def parse_gene_name(col_name):
    col_name = col_name.strip()
    if '(' in col_name:
        return col_name.split('(')[0].strip()
    return col_name

# Build gene -> column index maps (integer positions in file)
crispr_gene_to_idx = {}
for i, col in enumerate(crispr_header):
    if i > 0:
        gene = parse_gene_name(col)
        if gene not in crispr_gene_to_idx:
            crispr_gene_to_idx[gene] = i

omics_gene_to_idx = {}
for i, col in enumerate(omics_header):
    if i > 0:
        gene = parse_gene_name(col)
        if gene not in omics_gene_to_idx:
            omics_gene_to_idx[gene] = i

common_genes = sorted(set(crispr_gene_to_idx.keys()) & set(omics_gene_to_idx.keys()))
print(f"Common genes: {len(common_genes)}", flush=True)

# Use INTEGER column indices (these preserve order in pandas)
crispr_col_indices = [0] + [crispr_gene_to_idx[g] for g in common_genes]
omics_col_indices = [0] + [omics_gene_to_idx[g] for g in common_genes]

print(f"Step 3: Loading CRISPR data...", flush=True)
crispr_df = pd.read_csv(
    '/workspace/inputs/CRISPRGeneEffect.csv',
    usecols=crispr_col_indices,
)
# Column 0 is the cell line ID, rest are genes in common_genes order
crispr_df = crispr_df.rename(columns={crispr_df.columns[0]: 'cell_line'})
crispr_df = crispr_df[crispr_df['cell_line'].isin(omics_ids_set)]
crispr_df = crispr_df.set_index('cell_line')
# Assign gene names to columns (in the same order as common_genes)
crispr_df.columns = common_genes
crispr_df = crispr_df.astype(np.float32)
print(f"CRISPR shape: {crispr_df.shape}", flush=True)

print(f"Step 4: Loading expression data...", flush=True)
omics_df = pd.read_csv(
    '/workspace/inputs/OmicsExpressionProteinCodingGenesTPMLogp1BatchCorrected.csv',
    usecols=omics_col_indices,
)
omics_df = omics_df.rename(columns={omics_df.columns[0]: 'cell_line'})
omics_df = omics_df[omics_df['cell_line'].isin(crispr_ids_set)]
omics_df = omics_df.set_index('cell_line')
# Reorder to match CRISPR row order
omics_df = omics_df.loc[crispr_df.index.tolist()]
omics_df.columns = common_genes
omics_df = omics_df.astype(np.float32)
print(f"Expression shape: {omics_df.shape}", flush=True)

# Verify alignment
assert list(crispr_df.index) == list(omics_df.index), "Row mismatch!"
assert list(crispr_df.columns) == list(omics_df.columns), "Column mismatch!"

# CRITICAL: Verify by comparing with manually-loaded values
print("Step 5: Verifying alignment with manual checks...", flush=True)
check_genes = ['MYC', 'SGF29', 'PAICS', 'ILK', 'KRAS', 'TP53']
for gene in check_genes:
    # Manual load
    crispr_full_col = None
    omics_full_col = None
    for col in crispr_header:
        if parse_gene_name(col) == gene:
            crispr_full_col = col
            break
    for col in omics_header:
        if parse_gene_name(col) == gene:
            omics_full_col = col
            break

    if crispr_full_col and omics_full_col:
        manual_crispr = pd.read_csv('/workspace/inputs/CRISPRGeneEffect.csv', usecols=['Unnamed: 0', crispr_full_col])
        manual_omics = pd.read_csv('/workspace/inputs/OmicsExpressionProteinCodingGenesTPMLogp1BatchCorrected.csv', usecols=['Unnamed: 0', omics_full_col])
        manual_crispr = manual_crispr.rename(columns={'Unnamed: 0': 'cell_line'})
        manual_omics = manual_omics.rename(columns={'Unnamed: 0': 'cell_line'})
        manual_crispr = manual_crispr[manual_crispr['cell_line'].isin(omics_ids_set)]
        manual_omics = manual_omics[manual_omics['cell_line'].isin(crispr_ids_set)]
        manual_crispr = manual_crispr.set_index('cell_line')
        manual_omics = manual_omics.set_index('cell_line')
        common_idx = manual_crispr.index.intersection(manual_omics.index)

        x_manual = manual_crispr.loc[common_idx].iloc[:, 0].astype(float).values
        y_manual = manual_omics.loc[common_idx].iloc[:, 0].astype(float).values
        mask = ~(np.isnan(x_manual) | np.isnan(y_manual))
        rho_manual, _ = spearmanr(x_manual[mask], y_manual[mask])

        # Full matrix approach
        x_full = crispr_df[gene].values
        y_full = omics_df[gene].values
        mask_full = ~(np.isnan(x_full) | np.isnan(y_full))
        rho_full, _ = spearmanr(x_full[mask_full], y_full[mask_full])

        # Also check raw values match for first 5 rows
        first_5_match = np.allclose(x_manual[mask][:5], x_full[mask_full][:5], rtol=1e-4)

        print(f"  {gene}: manual={rho_manual:.6f}, full_matrix={rho_full:.6f}, "
              f"match={abs(rho_manual - rho_full) < 1e-5}, first5_match={first_5_match}",
              flush=True)

print("Step 6: Computing Spearman correlations for all genes...", flush=True)

crispr_arr = crispr_df.to_numpy()
omics_arr = omics_df.to_numpy()

n_cells, n_genes = crispr_arr.shape
print(f"Processing {n_genes} genes across {n_cells} cell lines", flush=True)

count_ge_06 = 0
count_le_neg06 = 0

for j in range(n_genes):
    x = crispr_arr[:, j]
    y = omics_arr[:, j]

    mask = ~(np.isnan(x) | np.isnan(y))
    n_valid = mask.sum()
    if n_valid < 10:
        continue

    x_clean = x[mask]
    y_clean = y[mask]

    if np.all(x_clean == x_clean[0]) or np.all(y_clean == y_clean[0]):
        continue

    try:
        rho, _ = spearmanr(x_clean, y_clean)
        if np.isnan(rho):
            continue

        if rho >= 0.6:
            count_ge_06 += 1
        if rho <= -0.6:
            count_le_neg06 += 1
    except Exception:
        continue

    if (j + 1) % 2000 == 0:
        print(f"  {j+1}/{n_genes}: rho>=0.6={count_ge_06}, rho<=-0.6={count_le_neg06}", flush=True)

print(f"\n=== FINAL RESULTS ===", flush=True)
print(f"Genes with rho(expression, CRISPR_score) >= 0.6: {count_ge_06}", flush=True)
print(f"Genes with rho(expression, CRISPR_score) <= -0.6: {count_le_neg06}", flush=True)

# The question asks for positive Spearman correlation between expression and essentiality.
# In DepMap, CRISPR gene effect scores: negative = gene knockout reduces viability = essential.
# Essentiality (degree of dependency) = -(CRISPR gene effect score).
# So rho(expression, essentiality) = rho(expression, -CRISPR_score) = -rho(expression, CRISPR_score).
# Strong positive (>= 0.6) means rho(expression, essentiality) >= 0.6.
# This is equivalent to rho(expression, CRISPR_score) <= -0.6.

answer = count_le_neg06

import os
os.makedirs('/workspace/codex_output', exist_ok=True)
with open('/workspace/codex_output/answer.txt', 'w') as f:
    f.write(str(answer) + '\n')

print(f"\nAnswer (essentiality interpretation, rho<=-0.6): {answer}", flush=True)

import numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr

# Load data exactly as in v4 (verified approach)
crispr_ids_all = pd.read_csv('/workspace/inputs/CRISPRGeneEffect.csv', usecols=[0]).iloc[:, 0].tolist()
omics_ids_all = pd.read_csv('/workspace/inputs/OmicsExpressionProteinCodingGenesTPMLogp1BatchCorrected.csv', usecols=[0]).iloc[:, 0].tolist()
crispr_ids_set = set(crispr_ids_all)
omics_ids_set = set(omics_ids_all)

crispr_header = pd.read_csv('/workspace/inputs/CRISPRGeneEffect.csv', nrows=0).columns.tolist()
omics_header = pd.read_csv('/workspace/inputs/OmicsExpressionProteinCodingGenesTPMLogp1BatchCorrected.csv', nrows=0).columns.tolist()

def parse_gene_name(col_name):
    col_name = col_name.strip()
    if '(' in col_name:
        return col_name.split('(')[0].strip()
    return col_name

crispr_gene_to_idx = {}
for i, col in enumerate(crispr_header):
    if i > 0:
        gene = parse_gene_name(col)
        if gene not in crispr_gene_to_idx:
            crispr_gene_to_idx[gene] = i

omics_gene_to_idx = {}
for i, col in enumerate(omics_header):
    if i > 0:
        gene = parse_gene_name(col)
        if gene not in omics_gene_to_idx:
            omics_gene_to_idx[gene] = i

common_genes = sorted(set(crispr_gene_to_idx.keys()) & set(omics_gene_to_idx.keys()))

# Load full data with correct alignment (same as v4)
crispr_col_indices_needed = set([0]) | set(crispr_gene_to_idx[g] for g in common_genes)
omics_col_indices_needed = set([0]) | set(omics_gene_to_idx[g] for g in common_genes)
crispr_col_indices = sorted(crispr_col_indices_needed)
omics_col_indices = sorted(omics_col_indices_needed)

print("Loading CRISPR...")
crispr_df = pd.read_csv('/workspace/inputs/CRISPRGeneEffect.csv', usecols=crispr_col_indices)
col_to_gene = {}
for col_name in crispr_df.columns[1:]:
    gene = parse_gene_name(col_name)
    if gene in common_genes:
        col_to_gene[col_name] = gene
crispr_df = crispr_df.rename(columns={crispr_df.columns[0]: 'cell_line'})
crispr_df = crispr_df[crispr_df['cell_line'].isin(omics_ids_set)]
crispr_df = crispr_df.set_index('cell_line')
crispr_df = crispr_df.rename(columns=col_to_gene)
crispr_df = crispr_df[common_genes]
crispr_df = crispr_df.astype(np.float32)

print("Loading Omics...")
omics_df = pd.read_csv('/workspace/inputs/OmicsExpressionProteinCodingGenesTPMLogp1BatchCorrected.csv', usecols=omics_col_indices)
col_to_gene_o = {}
for col_name in omics_df.columns[1:]:
    gene = parse_gene_name(col_name)
    if gene in common_genes:
        col_to_gene_o[col_name] = gene

omics_df = omics_df[omics_df['cell_line'].isin(crispr_ids_set)]
omics_df = omics_df.set_index('cell_line')
omics_df = omics_df.rename(columns=col_to_gene_o)
omics_df = omics_df[common_genes]
omics_df = omics_df.loc[crispr_df.index.tolist()]
omics_df = omics_df.astype(np.float32)

crispr_arr = crispr_df.to_numpy()
omics_arr = omics_df.to_numpy()

print("Finding genes with strong correlations...")
n_cells, n_genes = crispr_arr.shape

results_neg = []
results_pos = []

for j in range(n_genes):
    x = crispr_arr[:, j]
    y = omics_arr[:, j]
    mask = ~(np.isnan(x) | np.isnan(y))
    if mask.sum() < 10:
        continue
    xc, yc = x[mask], y[mask]
    if np.all(xc == xc[0]) or np.all(yc == yc[0]):
        continue
    rho, _ = spearmanr(xc, yc)
    if np.isnan(rho):
        continue
    if rho <= -0.6:
        results_neg.append((common_genes[j], rho, mask.sum()))
    if rho >= 0.6:
        results_pos.append((common_genes[j], rho, mask.sum()))
    if (j+1) % 2000 == 0:
        print(f"  {j+1}/{n_genes}...")

print(f"\nGenes with rho(expr, CRISPR_score) <= -0.6 (equiv to rho(expr, essentiality) >= 0.6):")
for gene, rho, n in sorted(results_neg, key=lambda x: x[1]):
    print(f"  {gene}: rho(expr, crispr)={rho:.6f}, rho(expr, essentiality)={-rho:.6f}, n={n}")

print(f"\nGenes with rho(expr, CRISPR_score) >= 0.6:")
for gene, rho, n in sorted(results_pos, key=lambda x: -x[1]):
    print(f"  {gene}: rho={rho:.6f}, n={n}")

print(f"\nTotal with rho <= -0.6: {len(results_neg)}")
print(f"Total with rho >= 0.6: {len(results_pos)}")
